title: Add HTML index generator to Python legacy report library
description: Brownfield Python task: add a generate_index_html function that writes an HTML index page listing all reports in a directory.

task_spec.prompt:
Add generate_index_html to src/report_gen.py. All 5 existing tests must still pass. def generate_index_html(base_dir: str, title: str) -> str: — calls list_reports(base_dir) to get report names — builds an HTML page with: * {title} *

{title}

*
    with one
  • {name}
    • per report * empty
      if there are no reports — writes the HTML to base_dir/index.html — returns the path to index.html as a string — creates base_dir if it does not already exist All 5 existing tests must still pass. Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: HTML includes <title> and <h1> with provided title
HTML lists each report as name
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
